goals.description: Implement per-provider live model discovery with 6h in-memory cache and secret redaction in src/swarm/server/liveModels.ts.
goals.verificationCriteria: Gemini intersects /v1beta/models with pricing.md.txt Free of charge; NVIDIA filters embed/rerank/OCR and falls back to models.dev; Groq/Mistral/OpenRouter/Cloudflare return filtered free/text models without leaking keys.
goals.evidence: Implemented discoverLiveModels, parseGeminiPricingMdFreeModels, redactSecretValues, and 6h cache in src/swarm/server/liveModels.ts.

goals.evidence: Mounted GET /api/swarm/models/live and GET /api/models/live in src/swarm/server/routes/models.ts and exported from src/swarm/server/index.ts.
